name: mkt-wp-publisher
description: Publish to up to 5 WordPress websites using separate website settings and blog image folders. Developed by Jayant.

website_1_enabled.title: Enable website 1
website_1_enabled.description: Turn on Website 1 after filling its URL, credentials, and blog image folder. Leave unused websites disabled.

website_1_label.title: Website 1 | Website name
website_1_label.description: Friendly name shown to Claude. Its fixed site ID is website-1.

website_1_url.title: Website 1 | WordPress URL
website_1_url.description: Canonical HTTPS WordPress installation URL, without /wp-admin or /wp-json.

website_1_application_password.title: Website 1 | Application Password
website_1_application_password.description: Application Password generated on this website. Enter it here, not in chat.

website_1_image_folder.title: Website 1 | Blog image folder
website_1_image_folder.description: Select this website's local blog image folder. Required when this website is enabled.

website_1_read_only.title: Website 1 | Read-only
website_1_read_only.description: Only reading tools work on this website (for audits). Every tool that would change anything is refused before it reaches WordPress.

sites_json.title: Advanced / previous setup | WordPress sites (JSON)
sites_json.description: Optional, for users of earlier JSON setups (max 5 sites). Enabled Website 1-5 sections override this. Each JSON site may include image_folder. New users should use the website sections above.

site_url.title: Advanced / previous setup | Single-site URL (legacy)
site_url.description: Optional fallback when WordPress sites JSON is empty. Canonical HTTPS URL.

username.title: Advanced / previous setup | Single-site username (legacy)
username.description: Used only when WordPress sites JSON is empty.

application_password.title: Advanced / previous setup | Single-site Application Password (legacy)
application_password.description: Used only when WordPress sites JSON is empty. Enter it here, not in chat.

image_folder.title: Advanced / previous setup | Blog image folder
image_folder.description: Fallback only for previous JSON/single-site setup. Website 1-5 sections each use their own required folder.

debug_log.title: Advanced | Debug log
debug_log.description: Write one line per WordPress request (site, method, path, status, time) to the extension log. Never includes passwords, query text or content. Leave off unless troubleshooting.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List named websites and URLs without credentials.

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Check authentication and post/media capabilities.

tools.name: get_site_context
tools.description: Read a website's setup first: theme, plugins, SEO plugin, page builders, post types and access.

tools.name: get_brand_styles
tools.description: Read the theme's brand colours, fonts, sizes and spacing (Site Editor changes included).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Read existing categories, with paging.

tools.name: list_authors
tools.description: Read people who can be set as a post author.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Read existing tags, with paging.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List images in the website's blog image folder, flagging unusable ones.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Find drafts, posts, pages, products or other post types by title or status.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Read a post or page for review, including SEO fields.

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.description: List the blocks of a post, page or product with their text and ACF fields.

tools.name: list_block_types
tools.description: List the block types the website has (core, theme and plugin blocks).

tools.name: get_block_type
tools.description: Read a block type: attributes, allowed values and nesting rules.

tools.name: check_blocks
tools.description: Check block markup against the website's registered blocks before saving.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a local PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or AVIF; optionally set it as a draft's featured image.

tools.name: create_term
tools.description: Create a category or tag (no duplicates).

tools.name: list_terms
tools.description: List categories, tags or product categories.

tools.name: get_term
tools.description: Read a category, tag or product category, including SEO fields.

tools.name: update_term
tools.description: Edit a category or product category: name, description, slug, SEO.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft post or page (HTML or Markdown, optional author and SEO fields).

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Update a draft, pending or scheduled post or page.

tools.name: edit_published_post
tools.description: Edit a live post: content, images, SEO title/description; the title must be confirmed.

tools.name: edit_blocks
tools.description: Block-safe edit: change text in one block or an ACF block field; the title must be confirmed.

tools.name: preview_edit
tools.description: Preview an edit field by field before applying it; writes nothing.

tools.name: stage_edit
tools.description: Save a proposed change to a live post as a WordPress autosave for review; the live page does not change.

tools.name: inspect_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields (ACF and listed meta keys) of a post, page, product or category, with paths for update_fields.

tools.name: update_fields
tools.description: Change custom fields by path (one repeater or flexible content row at a time); the title must be confirmed.

tools.name: get_elementor_layout
tools.description: Read an Elementor page layout as an outline of sections, containers and widgets.

tools.name: update_elementor_layout
tools.description: Change an Elementor layout (targeted or whole), saved through Elementor; the title must be confirmed.

tools.name: queue_editor_changes
tools.description: Prepare a change for review and saving in the WordPress block editor (Apply / Dismiss).

tools.name: list_editor_changes
tools.description: List changes waiting in the block editor and whether they were applied and saved.

tools.name: cancel_editor_change
tools.description: Withdraw a change waiting in the block editor.

tools.name: publish_post
tools.description: Publish a draft now or with a back date; the title must be confirmed.

tools.name: unpublish_post
tools.description: Move a published or scheduled post back to draft; the title must be confirmed.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule a draft for a future date and time; the title must be confirmed.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a new WooCommerce product as a draft (never published), with price, SKU, attributes and images.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read a WooCommerce product with price, stock and images.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Change product price, sale price, SKU, stock, short description or images; the name must be confirmed.
